turn.user_message: What if a doctor will not confirm a date?
turn.context: Prompt 1 of bm-pr-04. Transcript 23: what is fixed is when a decision is made, not what is decided; a step-down that slips is an input to the next pass. bed-management.md §7.4.2: the 5 PM round confirms or corrects predictions. The evening background starts here.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Processes, turn 5 (the record stops at 31)

text: Then the bed is planned as likely, not confirmed. Nobody is called in for it until a doctor says yes.
bullets: Tojo uses the usual stay for that kind of patient, from your own past patients.
The 5 PM round asks once more. Most dates are settled there, before the 6 PM freeze.
If it is still open, it is asked again next morning. A missed date is logged, not punished.
chat.invite: Next, we can see where the planned admissions come from.
prompts: Where do planned admissions come from?
Who needs to agree to this?
How often will a likely bed be wrong?
chat.pointer: Step round the loop. At the 5 PM check, pick an answer to see where it goes.

blocks.title: No date is not a breakdown
blocks.deck: What happens to one bed when the doctor does not confirm. Step round it.

gate.question: Did the doctor confirm by 5 PM?

sheets.title: No date given
sheets.text: The doctor is busy or unsure. Nothing breaks. The patient simply has no confirmed date yet.
sheets.entry: Which teams would confirm least at first?

sheets.title: Likely date used
sheets.text: Tojo uses the usual stay for this kind of patient. The bed is planned as likely, not confirmed.
sheets.entry: Do you track usual stays by procedure?

sheets.title: Checked at 5 PM
sheets.text: The 5 PM round asks the doctor once more. Most dates are settled here, before the freeze.
sheets.entry: Who would ask the doctor at 5 PM?

sheets.title: Planned as confirmed
sheets.text: The bed goes into the 6 PM plan with a call-in time for the next patient.

sheets.title: Likely, asked again
sheets.text: The bed stays in the plan as likely. No patient is called in for it until the doctor confirms next morning.
sheets.entry: How often would a likely bed be wrong?

items.title: When a decision is made
items.text: The 1 PM, 2 PM, 5 PM and 6 PM times stay the same every day.

items.title: What the doctor decides
items.text: Who is fit to go home, and when, stays with the treating doctor.

sheets.title: When a decision is made
sheets.text: The plan needs its answers by set times. The times stay the same, busy day or quiet day.
sheets.entry: Which of these times would be hardest here?

sheets.title: What the doctor decides
sheets.text: The plan never decides who goes home. It only asks by when the doctor will say.
